verdict.rationale: BigQuery's docs say it supports open table formats including Apache Iceberg, Delta and Apache Hudi. Its Iceberg managed tables keep data in customer-owned storage buckets as a single copy that open-source and third-party engines can also use, and a community comment compares BigQuery external tables to Athena-on-S3 and reports BigQuery as much faster. Missing for 10: any explicit evidence of querying raw Parquet files, detail on how Delta tables are read in place (docs give only a one-line claim), and documentation of the external-table mechanics for object storage.
